summary: Iteration 11 — regression pass on the 4x2 mode-toggle grid, sub-grouped chip sections (Food/Bars/Explore) with per-group 'cuisine-toggle-more-<label>' buttons, flat chip lists for Drinks/Desserts/Shops/Fuel/Stay, guided-tour 8-tile Step 1 with 150-mi radius for explore/stay and 'guided-chips-more-<label>' per-group buttons, and full deal flows for Food (Order/Delivery present) vs Explore (Order/Delivery absent). Backend smoke (test_iter11_smoke.py, 4/4 pass at ZIP 10001): food, bars, explore, stay each return non-empty restaurants[] with every item stamped category==requested. Frontend @ 390x844 and 768w (preview URL): [data-testid=mode-toggle] renders all 8 tabs simultaneously as a grid (scrollWidth==clientWidth, i.e. NO horizontal scroll) at both widths — all of mode-food, mode-drinks, mode-bars, mode-desserts, mode-shops, mode-fuel, mode-explore, mode-stay visible and clickable. Sub-groups verified: Food shows the 7 requested labels (American & Comfort / Pizza & Pasta / Asian / Latin & Caribbean / Mediterranean & Middle Eastern / Breakfast & Lighter / Style); Bars shows the 5 (Beer & Cider / Wine & Spirits / Vibe / Music & Shows / Bar Games); Explore shows the 4 (Outdoors / Swimming / Attractions / Active & Games). Per-group 'more' buttons appear ONLY on groups with >10 items — correct: food -> cuisine-toggle-more-{american & comfort, asian}; bars -> cuisine-toggle-more-{wine & spirits, vibe}; explore -> cuisine-toggle-more-{outdoors, attractions, active & games}. Other groups have <=10 chips so no button is required. Flat categories: Drinks, Desserts, Shops, Stay each render 1 section with a single cuisine-toggle-more-<flat label> btn; Fuel renders 1 section with no more btn (only 6 chips, below the 12-limit). Chip selectability verified via [data-testid=cuisine-filter-*]: Tacos, Brewery, Karaoke, Gyms, Swimming Holes all found and turn active (bg rgb(30,158,99), the seasonal accent). Sushi was reachable after expanding cuisine-toggle-more-asian (initial script error was a double-click that collapsed the group again — not an app bug). Guided tour: Step 1 shows all 8 [data-testid=guided-interest-*] tiles including guided-interest-explore & guided-interest-stay; picking Explore -> Step 2's radius track label reads '1 MI ... 150 MI' as required (radiusMax=150 for explore/stay); ZIP 10001 -> Continue -> Step 3 shows the 4 Explore sub-group labels and three per-group buttons guided-chips-more-{Outdoors, Attractions, Active & Games}; selecting guided-chip-State Parks -> Continue -> guided-seal-button -> reveal card appears with real data. Full deal flow from main page: Food (mode-food + ZIP 10001 + spin-roulette-button) reveals a restaurant with 6 order-dropdown-<uuid> buttons AND an order-dropdown-trigger (Order/Delivery visible); Explore (mode-explore + ZIP 10001 + spin-roulette-button) reveals 'Washington Rock State Park — State Park · $$' with the light-line 'A great choice, locked in.' and ZERO order-dropdown-* buttons, ZERO 'Order/Delivery' text — supportsDelivery guard is working. No console errors, no pageerrors, no red screens across any flow.
critical_code_review_comments: Filters.jsx ChipSection uses hard-coded limit=10 for grouped mode (line 48) vs limit=COLLAPSE_LIMIT=12 for flat mode (line 62) — divergence is intentional (subgroups are shorter) but worth a comment; groups with <=10 chips correctly skip rendering the 'more' button (e.g. Pizza & Pasta 3, Beer & Cider 8, Swimming 6). Selection persistence across expand/collapse (selectedBeyond in Filters.jsx:85) still works and the useEffect on [label] correctly collapses when switching categories.

GuidedFlow.jsx GuidedChips (lines 27-61) mirrors the same pattern for the guided tour with limit=6 per group / limit=9 for flat — testid 'guided-chips-more-<groupKey>' is stable across all four Explore groups. radiusMax logic on line 147 (`mode === 'explore' || mode === 'stay' ? 150 : 50`) matches the main page's own radiusMax and correctly overrides the default 50-mi Slider on Step 2 for those two categories.

Home.jsx line 972-993 replaces the old horizontal chip scroller with a 4-col grid; at 390 CSS px the container ends up 342x118 with sw==cw==340 (no clipping). At 768 CSS px sw==cw==670, also no scroll. Touch targets are min-h-52 (52px, above the 44px accessibility floor).

homeConstants.js line 156 NO_DELIVERY_CATEGORIES=[shops, fuel, explore, stay] is the single source of truth for the order-button guard — verified end-to-end that reveal cards for explore render 0 order-dropdown-* elements while food renders 6+trigger. New Explore chips (Swimming Holes / Swimming Beaches / Public Pools / Aquatic Centers on Swimming; Theme Parks / Amusement Parks / Fairgrounds on Attractions; Gyms / Fitness Centers / Yoga Studios / Pickleball Courts / Tennis Courts on Active & Games) are all present in EXPLORE_GROUPS and render as selectable chips.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter11 verifies the four items from the review request: (a) 4x2 mode-toggle grid, (b) guided Step 1 8 tiles + explore/stay 150-mi slider + 'guided-chips-more-<label>' Step 3 buttons, (c) new Explore chips (Swimming Holes, Theme Parks, Gyms, Pickleball Courts etc.), (d) Filters ChipSection sub-groups for Food/Bars/Explore with 'cuisine-toggle-more-<label lowercased>' buttons; flat groups for Drinks/Desserts/Shops/Fuel/Stay retained. Cross-checked full deal flow: Food -> Order/Delivery buttons render; Explore -> no order buttons (supportsDelivery guard). Only test-quality caveat: when writing UI selectors, remember cuisine-toggle-more-<label> is emitted with `label.toLowerCase()` including spaces and '&' (e.g. 'cuisine-toggle-more-american & comfort', 'cuisine-toggle-more-active & games'); guided-chips-more-<groupKey> preserves the original case (e.g. 'guided-chips-more-Active & Games'). Backend curated fallback returns empty for some Google-only cuisines at ZIP 10001 (Tacos, Brewery) — use Burgers/Bars/Swimming Holes/Campgrounds in tests to guarantee non-empty results without needing Google Places quota.
